g.title: J8
g.text: Zero 2 W. Pin 1 is nearest the microSD slot, inner row (square pad on the underside). Pin 1 also feeds U2; see wiring-audio.

g.title: U5
g.text: Custom circuit in button-input.md. Buffered active-low outputs; six 10k pull-ups; Q1 heater switch with R41 pull-down. RETURN joins the star ground on board. Power terminals are in wiring-power. Connector layout pending.

g.title: U3
g.text: Retained module; E4 open. VCC 3.3 V. IN LOW energizes the coil. Coil supply and contacts are in wiring-power.

g.title: BTN
g.text: Four switch contacts plus common return. Populate positions 1-n. Each contact closes SWn to RETURN.

g.title: U6
g.text: Adafruit 4885, I2C address 0x44, beside the camera window. 3V pad is the breakout regulator output and stays unconnected.
